Malai Chicken Gravy, aka White Butter Chicken, a rich, smooth, silky, and velvety white gravy loaded with shredded chicken. This is genuinely one of the most delicious chicken gravies you’ll ever try, and trust me, it gives classic Butter Chicken some serious competition!
Pair it with hot rumali roti or butter naan for the ultimate experience. The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Do give this one a try. Happy Cooking!
